diskOptimizeEffect: Rewrite in the current format, preserving the file location and backing chain. Space savings depend on the disk contents.
diskOptimizeUnavailable: Optimization requires a writable raw/qcow2 disk with a complete chain, no child disks, and readable image information.
diskOptimizeConfirmCompression: I confirm that this optimization will use no compression.
diskOptimizeRemember: Remember this compression choice for future optimizations
diskOptimizePreferenceWaiting: Saving compression preference. Check the result before confirming optimization.
diskOptimizePreferenceUnknown: The preference save result is unknown. Check the original request; optimization will not continue automatically.
diskOptimizePreferenceFailed: The preference was not saved and optimization has not run. Review again, then uncheck Remember to proceed without saving.
diskOptimizeOverlaySkip: This imported disk has a backing disk. Post-import optimization was skipped and the chain is unchanged.
diskOptimizeNoneSkip: The disk has no actual compression. Post-import optimization is unnecessary.
diskOptimizeCompressionUnknown: Actual compression could not be determined. Optimization has not run.
operationTrackingHint: Reloading this tab can recover the original operation within the same login session and service run. It never resubmits automatically.
operationTrackingInvalid: Local tracking records are invalid or exceed the limit. New operations are blocked. Check server tasks before confirming that local tracking can be cleared.
operationTrackingUnavailable: Local tracking could not be saved, so the new operation was not submitted. Restore browser session storage before retrying. Existing tasks can still be queried.
operationTrackingConfirm: I have checked server tasks. Cleanup rebuilds invalid records and removes verified completed tracking while retaining known unresolved requests. It does not cancel or undo server operations. An unknown result is not a reason to repeat an operation.
diskContinuationLost: The disk request from before the reload has been recovered for status queries only. Guest filesystem expansion, saving optimization preferences, and other follow-up actions will not continue automatically.
hugepagesRecoveryHint: The hugepage request from before the reload has been recovered for status queries only. Saving after a CMA trial and other follow-up steps require a new confirmation.
preferenceRecoveryHint: The settings save request from before the reload has been recovered for status queries only. Unsubmitted edits are not restored.
diskRememberRecoveryHint: The optimization preference save request has been recovered. Checking its result will not continue disk conversion automatically. Review the disk operation again.
usbAcmRecoveryHint: The USB ACM request from before the reload has been recovered for status queries only. It will not save or apply again automatically.
hpProcessRecoveryHint: The signal request from before the reload has been recovered using the original process identity. No signal is sent again. A successful send does not mean the process has exited.
transferRecoveryHint: The upload record for this session has been recovered. Check server status first. Reloading never sends files or starts another upload automatically.
transferReselectHint: Select the same files in their original order. Their full contents must match before you explicitly resume uploading. Matching names and sizes alone are not enough.
transferHashing: Checking file contents. You can pause and select the files again.
transferFileMismatch: Selected files do not match the original upload
transferFileMismatchHint: The file names, order, sizes or full contents differ. No new chunks were sent. Select the original files again; the existing upload progress is retained.
transferRestoreUnavailable: The original upload may have expired or become unavailable. A missing record does not prove that installation or import did not run. Check server results before explicitly clearing local tracking.
imageInstallRecoveryHint: The original image save request has been recovered for status queries only. It will not save again or import automatically. The original destination is shown below.
graphicParallelHint: Connect each screen separately. Click a display or its controls to switch input.
graphicClipboardHint: Exchange plain text through this display connection when supported by the guest. Paste or copy manually. Sending does not confirm guest acceptance and does not type keystrokes.
graphicClipboardLimit: Up to 64 KiB of text per transfer. Disconnecting or switching screens clears this panel.
graphicClipboardMode_unavailable: Unavailable. Connect to a screen that allows input and supports a complete text exchange.
graphicClipboardMode_latin1: Basic text mode supports Latin-1 only; guest clipboard support is unconfirmed. Chinese and other characters require UTF-8 negotiation.
graphicClipboardSend_sent: Text handed to the current connection. Guest acceptance is not confirmed.
graphicClipboardSend_unavailable: Cannot send through this connection. Check the connection and input permission.
graphicClipboardSend_too_large: Text exceeds 64 KiB. Shorten it before sending.
graphicClipboardSend_encoding: UTF-8 has not been negotiated. These characters cannot be sent without loss. Your draft is retained and was not sent.
graphicClipboardSend_invalid: The text contains invalid characters or a null character and was not sent.
graphicClipboardReceive_too_large: Received text exceeds 64 KiB and was ignored. The previous received text is retained.
graphicClipboardReceive_invalid: Invalid received text was ignored. The previous received text is retained.
